title: Connect and validate a custom provider
steps: Open the provider connection editor (S03). Choose the supported API family and execution host.
Enter the endpoint and an environment/vault reference. Never type a secret value into shared config.
Test reachability, authentication, model catalog and the exact model capability separately. Each stage has a bounded deadline and its own result (p.028).
Inspect the capability sheet: context, output, tools, parallel tools, reasoning, thinking, vision, documents, streaming, structured output, authority and cost/limit provenance.
Save the staged draft only after the secure binding is acknowledged. The save is one validated patch; a failure writes nothing.
Pick the model in S02 and tune only adapter-offered parameters in S05. Unsupported parameters must be rejected before dispatch.
forbidden_fake_states: fake capability authority from a model marketing name
fake effective state from a green toast
complete_when: provider/model pair and supported normalized tuning are captured only after acknowledgement (p.183).
